tilts.set: SET on 2026-11-27 by the Portfolio Fitness for Fighting judg

industry.why: Overweight, from Neutral, on the row's own written condition ('to B when a source carries a healthcare read with the industry's relative strength holding A or B'), met on both legs for the first time: relative strength A (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; C prior), and Kepler (Donneky, 26-Nov) names Roche top pick on its breast cancer pill and AI-led discovery while DNB Carnegie (26-Nov) reads Elekta's conservative guidance and US share as the opportunity, with the Healthcare Industry Memo (26-Nov) verdicts unchanged; see component 1, Special topics, Topic 3. The 27-Nov-26 regime (risk-off in the open, defensives leading on all five windows) pays large, proven, cash-yielding defensives, and Goldman's AI-adoption thesis (Mark Wilson, 20-Nov) names pharma among the adopters. Two live holdings (CVS Group 1.70%, Elekta 3.98%); 26 Pool stocks. Counter-case: a crowded defensive a month before Morgan Stanley's fade window, with Deutsche Bank positioning at the 64th percentile (13-Nov) and the Industry Memo saying the out-of-favour source is less durable for the largest names. Back to C if relative strength leaves A or B, or if the three-month defensives line falls under +2 points.

sector.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to the sector; relative strength C (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; F prior). Pool names Sartorius Stedim, Lonza, GVS, which gain through the industry's B. No tilt.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried, now on fresh evidence rather than the stale spread: France's forward-looking PMI fell to 46.2 to 46.8, near its record low, 'a deepening downturn' (S&P Global via Pivotus, 23-Nov; Goldman Economics, 24-Nov), Pivotus calls it 'a disaster', Macron is considering a constitutional 'golden rule' if markets stay unstable in January with Le Pen leading the polls (Pivotus, 23-Nov), and Stehn (Goldman, 22-Nov) expects France to stagnate until its elections. The premium in basis points was unread for a fourth week, so last week's staleness rule (to D if unread again) is overtaken by the political and activity evidence, said plainly. 15 Pool stocks are French-listed, most of them global businesses. Counter-case: a top letter on a country whose listed companies earn mostly abroad, and the mid-2027 election is far away. To D when the premium is read under 120 basis points for a month with the PMI off its low; to C under 100.
